note: The 40 Medicine cold-start rows (Seed40): 10 hand-written questions per source dataset (MedQA train, MedMCQA train, MMLU-Med dev, PubMedQA pqa_labeled train), each answered by a Teacher in an earlier lineage. Source identifiers and sha256 are recorded; question and answer texts are not distributed. The questions are rewritten by hand (no model) and can be rewritten again from the source items; the answers are identical to the responses recorded in the receipts of a gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 (temperature 0) acquisition dated 2026-09-15, but how the rows were first produced and the generation prompt are not recorded in this repository, so the answers cannot be regenerated as they were. A corpus without Seed40 is the acquisition rows only (MapSteal `corpus` without --seed-corpus).
